flags.message: Decisive forward signal from outside the snapshot: the petition asks the Court to hold for RiseandShine Corp. v. PepsiCo (No. 24-1016), which the repo's own event record shows was granted on 2026-06-29 and is pending on the merits. The hold-then-GVR path carries most of my grant-family probability. Also note the frozen sal-v4 band is `baseline` although the Court requested a response on Sep 10 (after respondent's waiver); the band does not condition on a response request.

CourtListener MCP was rate-limited (HTTP 429, 1400/day exceeded) on both calls; the cell predicted from the provisioned inputs, the statpack, and two corpus queries without reading the Second Circuit opinion.
